title: AIADRA shared - Part geometry_ref record (ADR/0005 D7 + D9 + ADR/0029 Part authoring SCN arc 20260531-13)
description: Engine-computed geometric artifact reference carried in a Part's `geometry_ref` namespace + in `part_changed.geometry_ref_delta` operations. Reconciles with ADR/0005 D7 (role enum + vault_ref required) + D9 (adapter_ref shell preserved per ADR/0027 D18) per Codex1 B5 absorption.

id.description: Stable list-addressable id per S0 commitment 7 (geom_NNNN; engine-allocated; immutable across the geometry record's lifetime within the Part).

role.description: Per ADR/0005 D7. authoring_geometry = canonical Part kernel geometry computed from features. derived_export = D7-derived (STEP / IGES / mesh / render) retained as a Part-bound reference (e.g., a release-signed export). Each derived_export record carries `derived_from` lineage citing the authoring_geometry id(s) it was generated from.

vault_ref.description: REQUIRED Vault content-hash. Canonical anchor per ADR/0005 D7. Algorithm-qualified per ADR/0016 convention. Codex1 B5 absorption (arc 20260531-13): retained as REQUIRED canonical Vault anchor; adapter_ref.engine_artifact_ref remains the OPTIONAL adapter-shell field.

kind.description: Optional geometric kind discriminator. Engines may set or omit. Future MINOR SCN can extend the enum.

derived_from.description: Geometry-to-geometry lineage per ADR/0005 D7 — derived_export records cite authoring_geometry id(s) they were generated from. REQUIRED when role=derived_export (enforced by conditional below).

derived_from_feature_ids.description: Per ADR/0029 D5 + D6 + Codex1 B4 absorption: feature-to-geometry computation lineage for role=authoring_geometry records. Records which features were evaluated to produce this geometry. REQUIRED when role=authoring_geometry. The fold cross-checks each entry against fact_provenance.derived_from via the canonical `feature:<id>` address form per ADR/0029 D6.

adapter_ref.description: OPTIONAL adapter shell per ADR/0005 §9 + ADR/0027 D18 wire-name preservation. When present: engine + adapter_schema_version REQUIRED; engine_artifact_ref + stable_engine_object_id OPTIONAL. Distinct from the required vault_ref above which carries the canonical Vault content-hash for the geometric artifact itself.

bounding_box_mm.description: Optional cached axis-aligned bounding box in millimeters (canonical unit at field-name level per ADR/0029 D10). Engines responsible for keeping fresh; aiadra-core does not enforce recompute. Codex1 N2: a future validator MAY check min <= max on each axis if this becomes query-critical.

category.description: Per ADR/0029 D6 + ADR/0028 D8: geometry_ref records are engine-computed derivatives. category MUST be 'computed_result'. Schema-rejects 'ai_proposal' / 'human_input' / 'measured' at the geometry_ref level (those belong on feature records or other namespaces).

derived_from.description: Per ADR/0029 D6 + Codex1 B4 + Codex2 B2 R3 absorption: REQUIRED non-empty for computed_result records. Canonical intra-Part entry form for authoring_geometry records is `feature:<feat_id>` (e.g., `feature:feat_0001`); for derived_export records it is `geometry_ref:<geom_id>`. Cross-Object forms `<object_uuid>:feature:<feat_id>` and `<object_uuid>:geometry_ref:<geom_id>` are reserved for a future SCN when cross-Part geometry derivation lands; v0.28.0 fold REJECTS them. Fold enforces STRICT set-equality (NOT subset coverage) between this list (filtered to the role's canonical form) and the corresponding declared inputs (`derived_from_feature_ids` for authoring_geometry; `derived_from` for derived_export). Neither under-covering (missing) nor over-attesting (dangling extras) is allowed. See validation/fold.py `_enforce_authoring_geometry_provenance_consistency` + `_enforce_derived_export_provenance_consistency` for the runtime authority.
